svg.text: StoreNode — Schema v3 (Brand / Store / Channels / Roles)

g.text: access: security-definer fns only — never PostgREST
brand ⇔ parent_id null · store ⇔ parent = brand
cascade: role at node (via node_members) covers all children
one is_primary per (node, type) · pin = store only
tokens → Vault, keyed by row id
no direct insert policy — created only via claim_store_reward()
birthday reward: unique (node, phone, reward_year) · one/yr
'requested' = reserved by a pending reward_redemptions row
optional row per node — RPCs fall back to
rate=1 / cap=true if none exists (static default for now)
no direct insert/update — created via request_reward_redemption()
approve → node_rewards.claimed · reject → back to unclaimed
transcribed client-side via Chrome Web Speech API
no direct insert — created only via submit_voice_review()
